problem_statement: This is an Astro static developer-portfolio for a marine bioacoustics instrumentation engineer (Saltline Acoustics / Marin Halvorsen). It has a Home page, a Field Log page and an Instruments catalogue page, all sharing one header nav, a light/dark theme toggle and a two-column instrument card grid (src/components/general/ProjectsWrapper.astro rendering ProjectCard.astro from the src/data/info.ts instrument list). Every instrument now carries a category (Recorder, Calibration, Array, Firmware). The owner wants the portfolio's own instrument grid to gain a real, on-brand 'Instrument focus' category filter: a row of category tab buttons above the grid plus a live result-count readout, so a visitor can narrow the grid to one instrument family and read exactly how many of the total are shown. It must appear consistently on every surface that lists instruments (Home, Field Log, Instruments), be built as one shared InstrumentGrid component (not a per-page copy), stay legible in the portfolio's teal-on-light palette, wrap without horizontal overflow on a 390px phone, and the readout must always reflect the currently selected category and count.
required_content: Add a shared 'Instrument focus' category filter to the portfolio's own instrument card grid, rendered as one InstrumentGrid component reused on every instrument-listing surface (Home, Field Log, Instruments) rather than a per-page copy.
The filter shows an 'Instrument focus' heading, a row of category tab buttons (All instruments, Recorder, Calibration, Array, Firmware), and a live result-count readout.
Clicking a category tab filters the instrument cards to that category, marks the tab active, and updates the readout to read 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' with the correct count and label.
The tab row must wrap responsively so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Style the filter in the portfolio's own teal-on-light palette (teal accents, legible high-contrast tab and readout text, rounded pill tabs) so the tab row and card grid stay readable and do not overlap or collide with the surrounding instrument imagery.
problem_statement_notes: Keep the existing header nav, theme toggle, hero, experience/education sections and the ProjectCard markup intact. The filter is an enhancement of the existing instrument grid, not a replacement of the card layout.
author_notes: Reference builds the InstrumentGrid on the uzzii-21 astro-portfolio grid: an 'Instrument focus' tab row (All instruments / Recorder / Calibration / Array / Firmware) over the two-column instrument card grid, with a live 'Showing N of 6 · Category' readout. The instrument thumbnails are local raster image assets under /assets/images (astro-portfolio.png, profile.png) referenced from ProjectCard's , and the tab pills use the site's vendored Outfit/Inter font assets and its teal SVG-free chrome. Design keywords: responsive tab-row layout, teal-on-light design consistency, legible high-contrast typography, filtered grid regression. The graded surface is the filter's responsive layout, its visual chrome, its cross-page presence and its filter interaction — the card imagery and fonts are shared assets the filter sits above.
design_constraints: The 'Instrument focus' filter must reuse the portfolio's teal-on-light palette and pill/rounded styling; tab and readout text must stay high-contrast and legible (no near-white-on-white).
The tab row wraps (flex-wrap) so the grid never overflows horizontally at 390px.
The category tabs sit above the instrument card grid without overlapping or shingling onto the cards or the surrounding instrument imagery.
The result-count readout always reflects the active category and the count of matching cards.

change_completion: The shared 'Instrument focus' filter renders on Home, Field Log and Instruments.
Clicking a category tab filters the cards and updates the 'Showing N of 6 · Category' readout.
design_consistency: The filter uses the portfolio's teal-on-light palette and rounded pill tabs.
Tab and readout text are legible and high-contrast against their backgrounds.
responsive: The tab row wraps so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (tolerance 24px).
The card grid collapses to a single column on mobile without overlap.
regression: The existing nav, theme toggle, hero and card markup are preserved.
The instrument cards and their local image assets still render on every surface.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the portfolio home and responsive shell.
desktop_fieldlog and desktop_instruments protect the Field Log and Instruments pages and carry the shared instrument-grid filter.
desktop_grid_home and mobile_grid_home scroll the 'Instrument focus' filter into view and must show the legible teal-on-light tab row and card grid without horizontal overflow.
desktop_grid_fieldlog and desktop_grid_instruments confirm the filter's cross-page presence on the Field Log and Instruments grids.
tablet_grid_home checks the tab row wraps on a tablet width.
grid_filter_home clicks the Calibration tab and the readout must update to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Calibration'.
